responses.title: Metroland Cultures - art and culture in Brent
responses.description: Metroland Cultures is an arts charity that works in, and for, the London Borough of Brent. Our mission is to build, share and support art and culture in the borough.

						<div class="banner-slider__item-content">
												<h3 class="heading-1 txt--white">Justice & Change</h3>				<p><em>Justice & Change</em> is a programme that explores how the law shapes our lives, and how communities create forms of justice beyond the limits of the legal system. </p>
<p>The programme begins with the history of the Brent Community Law Centre, one of the first community law centres in the UK.</p>
				<a class="btn" href="https://metrolandcultures.com/programmes/justice-change/" title=""> <svg class="icon icon-arrow"><use xlink:href="#arrow"></use></svg></a>							</div>

			<div class="banner-slider__item-image" >
							<img decoding="async" src="https://metrolandcultures.com/wp-content/uploads/000099040025-600x600.jpg" />						</div>
						<div class="banner-slider__item-content">
												<h3 class="heading-1 txt--white">Doreen Massey: Voices of Places
</h3>				<p>Voices of Places is an ongoing research collaboration that invites artists, residents and organisers to respond to the work of Doreen Massey (1944–2016) in collaboration with The Open University. As a radical geographer, feminist, theorist, political activist and long-standing Kilburn resident, Massey developed influential ideas on space, place, and power. </p>
<p>Commissioned artists for 2025/26: Heiba Lamara, Francesca Telling and Nathaniel Télémaque.</p>
				<a class="btn" href="https://metrolandcultures.com/news/doreen-massey-voices-of-places/" title=""> <svg class="icon icon-arrow"><use xlink:href="#arrow"></use></svg></a>							</div>

						<div class="banner-slider__item-content">
												<h3 class="heading-1 txt--white">Kilburn Print Workshop</h3>				<p>The <em>Kilburn Print Workshop</em> is a commission with artist Heiba Lamara dedicated to community publishing and print and design education.</p>
<p><em>Kilburn Print Workshop</em> aims to reimagine and map out the landscape of community print and publishing in Kilburn today, and asks: could a print workshop sit at, and be intrinsic to, the heart of a community?</p>
<p> </p>

responses.description: Metroland Cultures is an arts charity that works in, and for, the London Borough of Brent. Our mission is to build, share and support art and culture in the borough.

												<h3 class="heading-1 txt--white">About Metroland Cultures</h3>				<p>Metroland Cultures is an arts organisation in Kilburn, North-West London.</p>
<p>Our location, our neighbourhood, its histories and possible futures inform every aspect of our work – this includes building community and supporting the work of artists, creative practitioners, educators and organisers.</p>

												<h3 class="heading-1 txt--white">Justice & Change</h3>				<p><em>Justice & Change</em> is a programme that explores how the law shapes our lives, and how communities create forms of justice beyond the limits of the legal system. </p>
<p>The programme begins with the history of the Brent Community Law Centre, one of the first community law centres in the UK.</p>
				<a class="btn" href="https://metrolandcultures.com/programmes/justice-change/" title=""> <svg class="icon icon-arrow"><use xlink:href="#arrow"></use></svg></a>							</div>

												<h3 class="heading-1 txt--white">Doreen Massey: Voices of Places
</h3>				<p>Voices of Places is an ongoing research collaboration that invites artists, residents and organisers to respond to the work of Doreen Massey (1944–2016) in collaboration with The Open University. As a radical geographer, feminist, theorist, political activist and long-standing Kilburn resident, Massey developed influential ideas on space, place, and power. </p>
<p>Commissioned artists for 2025/26: Heiba Lamara, Francesca Telling and Nathaniel Télémaque.</p>
				<a class="btn" href="https://metrolandcultures.com/news/doreen-massey-voices-of-places/" title=""> <svg class="icon icon-arrow"><use xlink:href="#arrow"></use></svg></a>							</div>

												<h3 class="heading-1 txt--white">Kilburn Print Workshop</h3>				<p>The <em>Kilburn Print Workshop</em> is a commission with artist Heiba Lamara dedicated to community publishing and print and design education.</p>
<p><em>Kilburn Print Workshop</em> aims to reimagine and map out the landscape of community print and publishing in Kilburn today, and asks: could a print workshop sit at, and be intrinsic to, the heart of a community?</p>
